data.name: 拜剑·我们的冒险
data.detailed_description:
You will serve as a commander, guiding Melantha (from "Arknights") through various challenging campaigns. Your partners and opponents may hail from worlds you are familiar with or unfamiliar, defeating them to become stronger.

irregular updates

WASD - Movement Spacebar - Dodge/Sprint Left Button - Attack/Interact Right Button - Place Cards/Move Operators/Open Operator Skill Bar/Interact Left Button + Right Button - Sword Qi T - Time Slow Esc - Settings

Alt+F4 - Exit game

This game is a fan-made, unofficial, and non-profit doujin work created by enthusiasts.

Some of the materials used in this game have been explicitly authorized by the original creators. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to the relevant creators.

The characters, story backgrounds, and worldviews featured in the game may draw inspiration or reference from the settings of numerous classic works. The copyrights, trademarks, and all intellectual property rights of these elements belong to their respective legitimate copyright holders. This game is not affiliated with any of these official copyright owners.

We are committed to respecting the rights of all creators. If you are the copyright owner or relevant party of any content and have any concerns about our usage, please contact us immediately. After verifying the information, we will respond promptly and handle the matter according to your wishes.

We strongly recommend that all players support the original official works and legitimate channels of the referenced elements.

data.short_description: You are a commander, and you will strategically arrange all your cards to defeat opponents from various worlds. It's not just about sparring and combat; you may be able to achieve endings that those worlds never reached by reconstructing the storybook.
